law.storage: one plus genes each live tick
law.resource: finite shared reservoir; full keyed enumeration among cells with capital >= storage plus one
law.editing: one blind family-then-target edit at world ticks 0,3,6,...; external one paid blind edit after birth; frozen none; disabled and masked refusals retained
law.reproduction: one funded request per living start-of-tick cell; lowest empty site; repeated births permitted, at most 32 retained cells
law.death: retained cell, releases site, consumes no resources; clock advances through idle receipts
law.local_bank: shared allocation credits local bank by 16 before the declared resource phase; no other credit; bank settles to zero each tick
law.birth: copy stable serial holes, next serial, complete editor policy; nonheritable resets full founder baseline; deterministic immutable child identity seed; newborn participates next tick
law.variation: exact five-family regulation_contract.json kernel, no utility input
law.authored: only fixed version_witness probes; authored origin never autonomous discovery

sampling.population: all retained living and dead cells; preserve empty and outside-horizon slots
sampling.novelty: first postfounder executable stage absent from founder and every earlier stage on the selected path; reacquisition is not new discovery
sampling.versions: every retune and policy rewrite has an explicit version; neutral edits retain organization acquisition identity; neutral duplicates copy source acquisition; deletion tombstones are retained
sampling.birth_cutoff: stop each ancestor at the selected actual paid birth; full serial and policy mapping; nonheritable resets founder identities
sampling.pairs: all pairs of retained novel acquisitions, no outcome selection; activity and transmission use exact acquisition identity

assay.request_cache: role plus stage sequence; freeze complete request denominator before outcomes
assay.meaning: engineering measurement only; no endpoint utility is used in development selection or mutation

remaining_readiness: durable partial campaign routes and replay receipts
scientific sampling and thresholds on new worlds
